final.summary: This issue was resolved as fixed in 2024. The finding was reported again by a later scan; the earlier decision does not say whether the current code still has the fix.

precedents.title: Template prints the notice text without escaping
precedents.quote: Fixed in PR 61: the template uses <%= %> so Mojolicious escapes the notice body.

caveats: The decision predates the scan that reported this finding again.
